items.title: Witch Feeding an Owl
items.alt: A witch offers a small food dish to an owl perched on a wooden stand.
items.description: A witch holds a tiny food dish on her gloved forearm while a small owl perches on a short freestanding wooden stand beside her. Use this illustration for woodland fantasy stories and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Shelving a Book
items.alt: A librarian witch lifts a teal book toward a small shelf while holding another book.
items.description: A bespectacled librarian witch lifts a closed teal book toward a small shelf while holding a second book against her cardigan. Use this illustration for reading challenge cards and personal book journals.

items.title: Witch Polishing a Boot
items.alt: A seated witch polishes a curled-toe boot with a cloth.
items.description: A seated witch uses a cloth to polish one curled-toe boot on her lap, its mate standing by the stool and a small polish tin nearby. Use this illustration for care and maintenance sequences and personal crafts.
